readings.Aries: You are not too much. You are, however, misdirected. Adjust the trajectory. Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.
readings.Taurus: The waiting you've been doing is almost over. You will need to be ready to move. Say the thing you've been rehearsing.
readings.Gemini: Two conversations are happening simultaneously and you're keeping both alive when one needs to end. Sleep on it before committing.
readings.Cancer: Your body is keeping score of everything your mind has processed and not processed. Listen to it. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Leo: The stage you've been avoiding is smaller than you imagine, and the audience is ready. Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.
readings.Virgo: Your willingness to work harder than necessary has served you. It has also cost you things. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Libra: You are so good at seeing others' perspectives that you have temporarily misplaced your own. Find it. Simpler is correct here.
readings.Scorpio: What you love, you love completely, and you never fully stop. This is a fact of your chemistry. What worked before will not work the same way this time.
readings.Sagittarius: Your laughter is one of your best qualities. Someone around you needs to hear it today. This situation responds well to direct engagement.
readings.Capricorn: The commitment you made is still the right commitment. The method may need updating. Trust the slow version of this over the fast one.
readings.Aquarius: There is an idea you've been developing privately that needs exposure to become real. Share it. The question matters more than the answer right now.
readings.Pisces: There is a vision you've had repeatedly that is trying to become real. Give it some of your practical attention. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
